posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
[You're the winner](http://www.holographyforum.org/phpBB2/profile.php?mode=viewprofile&u=207) of a contest that existed only in my mind until you registered. For some time now I've been watching the numbers climb toward 200 registered members and I wanted to do something special when that count was reached. (I've often thought that it would be nice to live a healthy active life to my bi-centennial, so 200 has some meaning for me).

So, what did you win?

A hologram of course!

You can pick from a random freebie (I have a variety of polymer holograms from 2x2" up to 4x4") or if you'd like one I've made [go to my gallery](http://www.dragonseye.com/holography/gallery.html). If you choose the latter I can also add the text "200!" at the bottom as part of the hologram.

All you need to do is make the choice and [send me an email](http://www.holographyforum.org/phpBB2/profile.php?mode=viewprofile&u=9) telling me which you'd like and what your address is.
